segments.text: A diver is collecting bodies from a sunken ship. Then one of the hands grabs him.
No chance. That ship had been on the sea floor for three days. Let's go look.
May {2013|twenty thirteen}, off Nigeria. Just before five A M, a wave flips a tugboat. Twelve men on board.
The cook, Harrison Okene, is in the bathroom. Seconds later he's upside down, {30|thirty} meters under, in total darkness.
He finds one pocket of air. Cold water to his chest. One bottle of Coke. That's everything.
A day passes. Then another. The air is running out. I'd have lost my mind. And my feathers.
Then, a light. Divers. He bangs on the wall. And the light swims away.
It comes back. So Harrison reaches into the water, and grabs the diver's hand. The diver screams. Fair.
Sixty hours down there. The only survivor. I was wrong. Case closed.
